title: registered source coverage gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求最新 source coverage closeout JSONL 覆盖所有 registered source id。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh source_coverage_ids check; missing-source negative fixture
risk: 只检查控制面覆盖，不替代 owner 语义决策。

title: source coverage required fields
decision: 每个 source coverage 行必须有 status、classification、decision、risk、owner 和 checked_at。
risk: 字段存在不等于内容正确；仍需 owner review。

title: source coverage gate remains read only
decision: 门禁只报错，不生成 coverage、不迁移 source、不修改索引。
risk: 人工仍需维护 coverage closeout manifest。
